name: tools_url_safety_sensitive_query_param_name
notes: First sensitive query-param NAME in a URL. Harness carries a faithful traced copy of src/tools/url_safety.c::sensitive_query_param_name and additionally calls the REAL linked port (extra_src) as an internal consistency check (exits 3 on divergence). Twin drives LIVE urlsplit/parse_qsl/unquote + _SENSITIVE_QUERY_PARAM_NAMES over the same rung order. SCOPE: C port splits pairs only on '&' and does not strip whitespace or handle '+' as space, so the input walk avoids ';'-separated, '+'-encoded and padded inputs where parse_qsl semantics would diverge. DOCUMENTED DIVERGENCE (1 input dropped): for percent-encoded sensitive keys (e.g. ?api%5Fkey=v), LIVE parse_qsl decodes the key and sensitive_query_param_name returns the DECODED name ('api_key'), while the C port urldecodes only for the membership test and returns the RAW text ('api%5Fkey'). Percent-encoded-key inputs excluded; worth a follow-up port fix.
